name: Inohae Valley

en.name: Inohae Valley
en.description: A lush forested valley with walking trails following a clear mountain stream past several waterfalls, moss-covered rocks, and subtropical vegetation. The trail is unmaintained in sections and can be slippery. Access is weather-dependent; the valley is not recommended during or after heavy rain.
highlights: Forested valley trail past waterfalls and mossy rocks
Subtropical flora and clear mountain streams
Quiet, uncrowded alternative to mainstream sights
en.openingHours: Daylight access only. Trail may close after heavy rain. Not maintained as a managed park.

ja.name: 猪八重渓谷
ja.description: 清流沿いの遊歩道が滝や苔むす岩、亜熱帯植物の中を縫って続く緑豊かな渓谷。一部整備不十分な区間があり滑りやすくなっています。雨天時・大雨後は非推奨。気象条件に左右される自然エリアです。
highlights: 滝と苔むす岩が続く森林渓谷トレイル
混雑しない静かな穴場スポット
ja.openingHours: 日中のみ通行可能。大雨後は通行止めあり。管理公園としては整備されていません。
